What iMerit / EXL sells

  • Ango Hub: Software for labeling and reviewing data, including medical images and LiDAR (laser measurements used to map three-dimensional surroundings).
  • Deep Reasoning Lab: Experts design tasks with several steps. They use model errors to create corrective training data.
  • iMerit Scholars: Domain specialists create training data and evaluate model reasoning.
  • Specialized data services: Managed data labeling and evaluation for healthcare and robotics, including autonomous vehicles.
  • 3D Multi Sensor Fusion: Combines LiDAR, radar and camera data so annotators can label objects consistently across sensors.
  • Radiology Annotation Co-Pilot: Helps radiologists label medical images in Ango Hub. It automates repetitive work and applies project-specific annotation rules.
